results.title: Marshall football: Montgomery relishing 'great reward' of leadership role
results.description: HUNTINGTON — Marshall offensive lineman Tariq Montgomery stands as a veteran leader in team meetings – now a redshirt senior spending his entire career with the Thundering Herd. Montgomery said he feels honored to bestow his experiences upon the younger players just as those before him. He does so alongside Jalen Slappy, Xavier Bausley and Evan Ferguson. “I feel like last year was the first year I actually had to step into the older leader role. When I was younger, I had Ethan Driskell, Dalton Tucker, Logan Osburn and all of those guys. They were our leaders,” Montgomery said. “Now, it’s time for me, Slap, Baus and Ferg to step up into that role. We’re trying to lead them like the guys in the past led us.”
